name: 3 Wildos
review:
3 Wildos is the third outing for Thunderkick's bandit gang, this time among pyramids and ruins on 5 reels with 9 paylines. Multiplier wilds add punch to base spins, and there are three free spins modes, each with its own power-ups.

The bonus brings retriggers and sticky multiplier wilds. Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 5,000x cap. Note the published RTP of 94.20%, below the industry average.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
